user.title: Set up Message Center
user.description: Choose the phones and tablets that receive the messages. Everything else is set afterwards on the page "Message Center" in the sidebar.

data_description.recipients: The phones and tablets with the Home Assistant app that receive the messages. At least one. They can be changed later on the Recipients tab of the Message Center page.

reconfigure.title: Recipients
reconfigure.description: Choose the phones that receive pushes.

data_description.recipients: The phones and tablets with the Home Assistant app that receive the messages. At least one. They can be changed later on the Recipients tab of the Message Center page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one message center can be set up.
abort.no_mobile_app: No Companion App device found. Install the Home Assistant app on a phone first.

send.name: Send
send.description: Send a message with explicit assignment (for senders that know their kind). Prefer notify.message_center for normal automations.

title.name: Title
title.description: Short and neutral; used to tell messages apart.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text shown on the phone.

data.name: Extra data
data.description: Passed on to the phone unchanged (image, actions, ...); must be storable as JSON.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Name or id of a message kind. An unknown kind is rejected (invalid_field).

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: 1 notice, 2 important, 3 alarm (3 only if allowed in the options).

key.name: Key
key.description: Replaces the title as the identity of the message.

discard.name: Discard
discard.description: Discard open messages that have not been delivered yet. Delivered messages and the phone are untouched. Needs the right to control the Message Center entities.

message_id.name: Message id
message_id.description: The id from the Open entity or the page.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Put a message back and deliver it again later. Needs the right to control the Message Center entities.

message_id.name: Message id
message_id.description: The id from the Open entity or the page.

forward.name: Forward to assistant
forward.description: Hand a message with its text and a note to the assistant via the event message_center_forwarded and, if one is chosen, a script. Needs the right to control the Message Center entities.

message_id.name: Message id
message_id.description: The id from the Open entity or the page.

note.name: Note
note.description: What the assistant should do with it.

list.name: List
list.description: Return all messages with state, reasons and text. Administrators only.

include_history.name: Include history
include_history.description: Also return ended messages from the history store.

priority_not_allowed.message: Priority 3 via send is not enabled. Allow it on the settings tab of the Message Center page or use a message kind.

store_full.message: Message Center holds 200 unfinished messages. Discard some or send held ones now on the Message Center page.

store_not_readable.message: Message Center cannot read its store ({error}). Home Assistant will try again.

store_not_writable.title: Message store not writable
store_not_writable.description: Message Center cannot write its store and rejects new messages. Check the disk and the permissions of .storage, then restart Home Assistant.

history_not_writable.title: Message history not writable
history_not_writable.description: Message Center cannot write its history file; messages are still taken and delivered. Ended messages wait in the working store, at most 1000 of them: beyond that the oldest can be lost. Check the disk and the permissions of .storage; the history is written again at the next hourly round.

store_full.title: Message Center is full
store_full.description: 200 open messages are stored. Discard or release held messages on the page.

unclear_messages.title: {count} message(s) with unclear delivery
unclear_messages.description: After a restart or a long gap it is unknown whether these messages reached the phones. Send them now or discard them on the page.

rule_entity_unavailable.title: Rule {name} cannot read {entity_id}
rule_entity_unavailable.description: The entity is unavailable or missing. The rule counts as active until the entity returns. Check the helper or integration behind it.

rule_max_duration.title: Rule {name} active longer than {hours} h
rule_max_duration.description: The rule exceeded its maximum duration; held messages were delivered and the rule no longer applies until its entity leaves the rule state.

recipient_unreachable.title: Recipient {name} not reachable
recipient_unreachable.description: Pushes to this phone fail for more than 15 minutes. Message Center keeps retrying for 24 hours. Check the Companion App on the phone.
